design.pair_interpretation: Each pair is an independent stationary draw of (Z_t,Z_t+1); this is not one long trajectory.
design.ground_truth_use: Only oracle dictionary and evaluation use Z; raw/poly2/identifiable SFA fitting is unlabeled.
design.poly2_boundary_warning: Poly2 of nonlinear observations does not exactly contain Z0 or H2(Z0); rho0^2 boundary is exact only for the oracle latent Hermite dictionary.
design.error_parameter_warning: signal_power is not the code MSE-based R2; both actual audit and analytic direct/optimal R2 are reported.

design.same_window_truth_denominator: known physical variance 1, matching archived low-dimensional A4/B experiment
design.ground_truth_use: No Z is used to fit whitening or lag eigenvectors. Principal-angle evaluation and signed permutation alignment use oracle Z-coordinate information. Top2 diagnosis uses all FOUR aligned eigenvectors, not only the extracted 2D representation.
design.subspace_metrics: signal-loading angle removes additive-noise ceiling; function-space angle includes the ceiling sqrt(1-signal_power).
design.residual_design: Independent unit-variance Gaussian AR residual. Isotropic rates all .5; slow-leak rates [.5,.5,.94,.94] in physical fast directions before a common orthogonal rotation.
design.population_bias: Signed boundary gap=R*(rho1^lag-rho2^lag)+(1-R)*(kappa1^lag-kappa2^lag). Isotropic residual has zero contrast bias. Negative boundary gap is a population ordering failure regardless of CAL size.

limitations: Synthetic Gaussian representation and oracle evaluation; no LeJEPA network is trained or evaluated.
R parameter is signal power; actual code MSE R2 is separately reported.
Poly2 observed dictionary is not the oracle latent Hermite span; an exact harmonic boundary cannot be transferred between them.
Harmonic study has one calibration draw per case/budget; nested budgets and common audit states are paired, not independent replications.
Phase has three CAL replicates; shared TEST across CAL fits cannot be counted as extra independent physical windows.
Full-axis top2 alignment uses physical identity oracle and is not a deployable unlabeled naming method.
No uniqueness/necessity theorem for identifiability or general neural-network phase transition is established.
